🎟️ Use codes REB1RTH and 60KVISITS for EPIC REWARDS! 🎟️

Welcome to Find The Pixel!
Break through millions pixels, alone or up to 4 friends, upgrade your balls, fight bosses and find the hidden Golden Pixel!

🌎 EXPLORE — Discover new biomes in a massive destructible world.
🔴 UNIQUE BALLS — Unlock balls with special abilities and new ways to destroy pixels.
👑 EPIC BOSSES — Face powerful bosses, each with a unique challenge.
💎 POWERFUL RELICS — Discover hidden relics to boost your progress.
💥 SATISFYING DESTRUCTION — Watch your balls bounce and tear through thousands of pixels!

Join our Roblox Group for CODES and UPDATE SNEAK PEEKS!

Inspired by 10 Million Pixels
